jc.t: Blessings at the Sunday assembly: "The mandir is done
w: It will happen here in the future."

In the evening assembly the kishores sang: "Jivan jivi janyu nahi to jindgi shaa kaamni" and presented a performance of historical figures like King Soloman, Alexander the Great, Elvis Prestly, Chanakya and others - each narrating their achievements and the subsequent emptiness and vaccum in their lives. This was followed by a drama presentation of devotees who have been transformed and blessed by Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Guru Parampara for the BAPS residential girls' school - Swaminarayan Vidyapith, Karamsad.
In the morning, the Kishore Day assembly was based on the subject of Niyam Dharma. The assembly was attended by 430 kishores and 180 kishoris.

In the evening, the Children's Day program included a march (kuchh geet) and the demonstration of a children's weekly assembly to show what children are taught. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Yuvak - Yuvati Din After Swamishri had darshan in the mandir, he released balloons to launch today's Yuvak-Yuvati Day, after which yuvaks sang various kirtans during Swamishri's puja. A special morning assembly was arranged for them, in which Doctor Swami addressed them. The highlight of the evening assembly was a drama performed by the yuvaks entitled 'Brahmanand Darshan'.

In his blessings to the assembly, Swamishri first praised the devotion and services of the Yuvak Mandal. He also stressed the importance of discourses in addition to seva, saying that without the understanding and knowledge provided by discourses, ego will come in the way and one will be unable to perfect one's devotion.

At 7.00 pm Swamishri arrived at the Rariton Expo Centre in Edison for the welcome function. A replica of Akshardham made of polystyrene formed the stage backdrop. Prior to Swamishri’s arrival senior sadhus had addressed the large gathering. On his arrival senior sadhus garlanded Swamishri. Thereafter the Mayor of Edison Hon. Jun Choi honoured Swamishri with a proclamation and declared the day as ‘Pramukh Swami Day’. The Mayor praised the BAPS and Swamishri in his address. Then Swamishri blessed the CEO of TV Asia Shri H.R. Shah and social worker Bharatbhai Shah. Shri H.R. Shah praised Swamishri as today’s sanskruti purush (culture personality). Children and youths performed a cultural dance and a drama on family disputes and miscommunication. Then Shukmuni Swami spoke on effective communication. Finally Swamishri blessed the function, “We are indebted to one’s family, society and country. But our obligation to God is the greatest. Whatever you have achieved, do not use it unethically. Live morally and spiritually and consolidate our cultural values in life. If the foundation of a building is strong then the building will stand for many years. So, one has to take care in constructing the foundation. If one becomes engrossed in material pleasures, the present lifestyles and wealth then one’s foundation will become weak. We must observe and preserve our values of truth, ahimsa, brahmacharya, compassion.” The assembly concluded at 8.30 pm. About 7,000 devotees and well-wishers were served with prasad.
